g.text: Japanese Director Naomi Kawase to Lead Doha Film Festival Jury ◆ Chris Brown Sentenced to Eight Months in Prison, Suspended for 12 Months, for ‘Vicious and Unprovoked’ Attack at U.K. Nightclub ◆ ‘You Can See Everything’ to Play at Italy’s Torino Film Festival With Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim in Tow as Buzzy Doc Starts International Launch ◆ Ecuadorian Queer Drama ‘Princess’ Swooped On by MMM Film Sales Ahead of Tallinn ◆ Greg Berlanti to Receive the Paley Center for Media’s Honors Award at Its Fall Gala ◆ Brian Gordon Takes Executive Producer, Head of Live Content Roles at PGA Tour Studios ◆

Japanese Director Naomi Kawase to Lead Doha Film Festival Jury ◆ Chris Brown Sentenced to Eight Months in Prison, Suspended for 12 Months, for ‘Vicious and Unprovoked’ Attack at U.K. Nightclub ◆ ‘You Can See Everything’ to Play at Italy’s Torino Film Festival With Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim in Tow as Buzzy Doc Starts International Launch ◆ Ecuadorian Queer Drama ‘Princess’ Swooped On by MMM Film Sales Ahead of Tallinn ◆ Greg Berlanti to Receive the Paley Center for Media’s Honors Award at Its Fall Gala ◆ Brian Gordon Takes Executive Producer, Head of Live Content Roles at PGA Tour Studios ◆
